rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority opinion narrow and institutionally framed around Davis/Garmon’s burden and a Sears-style property-damage pathway, which best holds the 7-Justice coalition together. Sotomayor likely writes the principal dissent (with Jackson possibly joining or adding a shorter dissent) warning that the majority’s foreseeability/precautions test invites state end-runs around Board-first uniformity.
